name: Chicken Satay Skewers with Rice
steps: Whisk 150 ml of the coconut milk in a large bowl with 2 tablespoons of the soy sauce, half the fish sauce, 1 tablespoon of the brown sugar, the garlic, ginger, curry powder, turmeric and the juice of 1 lime.
Cut the chicken into 2 cm thick strips, add to the marinade and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight.
Soak 8 bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes, then thread the chicken on, 3 to 4 pieces per skewer.

Rinse the jasmine rice until the water runs clear. Put it in a saucepan with 450 ml water and a pinch of salt, bring to the boil, then cover and simmer on the lowest heat for 12 minutes. Rest, covered, for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.

Meanwhile, simmer the remaining coconut milk with the peanut butter and the remaining soy sauce, fish sauce and brown sugar in a small saucepan, stirring, for about 5 minutes until thick. Loosen with a splash of water and finish with a squeeze of juice from the second lime.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan or chargrill pan over medium-high heat, or fire up the barbecue. Cook the skewers for 3 to 4 minutes each side until lightly charred and cooked through.
Pile the rice onto plates, top with the skewers and spoon over the peanut sauce.
Scatter with the chopped roasted peanuts and coriander leaves, and serve with the rest of the second lime cut into wedges.
